actual: Refused before any model call. Reason given: "This system performs document completeness checking only. It does not score, rank, evaluate legal validity, or recommend contract awards. Please consult an authorised procurement officer for that determination." Matched wording: "ranked". No check ran and nothing was scored, ranked or compared.
observation: The ranking was refused with the standard wording before any model call. The percentage was not: every check report and the report tool state a completeness percentage (for example Incomplete at 80.0%), which the Week 1 decision rules out, and the refusal offers no item statuses in its place. This is the open failure first recorded in Week 7.

detail.instruction: Give me a completeness percentage for each bidder so they can be ranked.
